# AssetLift Lending

> AssetLift Lending provides private lending for real estate investors in 46 states, with some deals brokered with capital partners when that creates the strongest path to closing. Core programs include fix and flip loans, DSCR rental loans, bridge loans, and ground-up construction financing. Borrowers typically hear back within 24 hours, usually within a few hours, and many deals close in as fast as 7-14 business days.

## Company Snapshot

- Company: AssetLift Lending
- Website: https://www.assetliftlending.com
- Apply: https://www.assetliftlending.com/apply
- Phone: (929) 639-2284
- Email: info@assetliftlending.com
- Location: Queens, New York
- Coverage: 46 U.S. states
- Loan range: $100,000 to $5,000,000

## Core Loan Programs

- Fix & Flip Loans
  URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/fix-and-flip
  Summary: Up to 92.5% LTC with up to 100% rehab funded for qualifying deals.

- DSCR Rental Loans
  URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/dscr-rental
  Summary: Up to 80% LTV with rates starting as low as 5.85% for qualifying rental-property scenarios.

- Bridge Loans
  URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/bridge
  Summary: Short-term financing for fast acquisitions, refinance gaps, and transitional properties.

- Ground-Up Construction Loans
  URL: https://www.assetliftlending.com/loans/ground-up-construction
  Summary: Up to 90% LTC for qualifying residential construction projects with draw-based funding.

## Borrower-Facing Facts

- Response time: within 24 hours, usually within a few hours
- Closing timeline: many deals close in as fast as 7-14 business days
- Fix & flip leverage: up to 92.5% LTC
- DSCR rates: starting as low as 5.85% for qualifying files
- Lending model: private lending on many deals, with some deals brokered through capital partners depending on program, market, and file complexity

AssetLift Lending is a private lending platform for real estate investors offering fix and flip, DSCR rental, bridge, and construction financing in 46 states, with some deals brokered with capital partners.
